references.text: Refers to a man of Aaron's lineage who has a discharge and is unclean, and must not eat the holy offerings until he is clean.
Command to send out from the camp anyone who has a discharge, in order to keep the camp pure.
David's curse on Joab's house mentions one with a discharge as a sign of God's judgment.
The woman with bleeding for twelve years who touched Jesus' cloak shows how Jesus heals what makes one unclean according to the law.
Mark's account of the woman with bleeding who was healed by Jesus, linked to uncleanness from discharges.
Luke's account of the woman with bleeding, who was unclean according to the Mosaic Law but was healed by Jesus.
